Two elongated Chinese dragons winding among auspicious curling clouds in shallow sculpted bas-relief, delicate scales, tasteful worn carved narrow cloud-scroll border. Carvings are raised smoothly from the flat stone field, not a flat ink illustration. Entire rectangular plaque viewed directly perpendicular to the face, no perspective, no visible sides or background, no staircase or architecture.

TOP THIRD: physical base-color/albedo only. Soft off-white marble, faint very low-contrast natural mineral variation and fine grain. All faces have the same reflectance. No directional highlights, no shadow, no ambient occlusion, no dark crevice shading, no rim light. Correct unlit base color is deliberately almost flat: sculptural depth belongs in the normal map, not in albedo. Not a photograph of shaded carving.
MIDDLE THIRD: actual tangent-space normal map of exactly the same bas-relief at identical UV coordinates and size. Conventional OpenGL +Y, flat areas RGB128,128,255. Convex dragon bodies and curved cloud profiles are encoded by smoothly varying cyan/pink/purple surface normals on blue, not by gray lighting. Mostly light neutral gray with restrained fine stone variation; aligned with the same carved surface. Roughness is material microstructure, NOT baked shadows, height, or specular lighting.
Precise alignment of all three tiles is essential. No cast shadows in any map. No black border. No labels. No fake photographic paper or scene backdrop. Make a production-ready material-channel atlas whose three equal row tiles can be extracted without editing the artwork.
